text:
Aisha CSM: Quick heads-up — Acme kickoff tomorrow 9:00am PT. Goal: get core chat + embeddings live in pilot by end of month. I pulled together stakeholders + initial risks.
Dana (AcmeOps): Thanks Aisha — confirmed for 9am. I'll bring the platform owners (network + security).
Tom Solutions: I'll cover integration plan and sample prompts. Can someone list the exact success criteria we want to sign off on during the pilot?
Marta PM: Proposed success criteria (short): 1) 95th perc latency < 700ms for 256-token requests, 2) embedding accuracy on our eval set >= 0.86, 3) uptime > 99.5% during business hours. Thoughts?
Ravi Eng: Latency target seems tight depending on quantization. We should scope expected traffic — are we starting with 10 TPS or 1 TPS?
Dana (AcmeOps): Start with 2 TPS steady, spikes to 8 TPS for import jobs. Renewal risk: if latency > 1s consistently, execs will push back.
Aisha CSM: Good call — add a renewal risk column: high if exec visibility + latency/accuracy miss. I'll own stakeholder comms.
Victor Enablement: I'll draft an enablement plan: 1) dev docs + sample code, 2) 45m internal workshop (devs + PMs), 3) post-kickoff FAQ. When should workshop be?
Marta PM: Schedule workshop during week 2 of pilot (we go live week 1). That gives devs time to integrate.
Tom Solutions: I can run the workshop. Can we capture feedback quickly? Suggest a short survey and a small eval harness (5 prompts) run daily.
feedback-bot: Reminder created — survey link: https://acme-surveys.example.com/quick-onboard (auto-send day 3), daily-eval job scheduled (cron: `0 10 * * *`).
Ravi Eng: For rollout, propose stages: canary (10% traffic), ramp 50% after 48h error < 0.5%, full roll at day 7 if no regressions. Also need a fallback plan to older model variant.
Aisha CSM: Owners: Integration owner = Tom, Runtime/ops = Ravi, PM success = Marta, Customer exec liaison = Dana. I'll create calendar invites and a shared OKR doc.
Dana (AcmeOps): Please add me to the OKR doc. Also, security: we need KMS key rotation documentation before go-live.
Ravi Eng: Noted — I'll add KMS notes to the repo and tag eng-security for review.
Marta PM: Success metric owners: latency — Ravi, embedding eval — Tom + Dana, user satisfaction — Victor.
Aisha CSM: Risk register snapshot: 
- High: Exec visibility + latency miss (owner: Aisha)
- Medium: Integration gaps for embeddings (owner: Tom)
- Low: Documentation gaps (owner: Victor)
Will circulate after meeting.
Tom Solutions: Quick ask — can eng infra enable dedicated capacity demo instance for the workshop? Need GPU-backed instance for live demos.
Aisha CSM: I'll coordinate with eng-infra after kickoff if we get a green light from the customer.
Dana (AcmeOps): Green light for demo instance as long as it's isolated in our VPC.
Victor Enablement: I'll prepare the workshop deck and a 5-question survey (Net Promoter style + feature asks).
Aisha CSM: Final checklist before tomorrow: meeting link + calendar, stakeholder roster, draft success criteria, risk register, demo infra ask, enablement draft. Ping me if anything missing. :thumbsup:
Tom Solutions: Got it. See you all at 9am PT.
Dana (AcmeOps): See you — sending access for test data now.
Ravi Eng: Thanks team — I'll bring initial perf numbers and a short runbook for fallbacks.
